title: No intial calibration with 0000
symptom: When starting a G6 sensor with code 0000 using a firmware that does not output raw data, after two hours the screen displays 'Needs Initial Calibration' but the 'Initial Calibration' option in the three bar pull down menu does not appear, so calibration cannot be provided.
cause: The sensor is waiting for a calibration before it gives a glucose value, and xDrip is waiting for a glucose value before it allows calibration, causing a deadlock. The menu item for initial calibration never appears with a 0000 start.
fix: A fix was provided in a test version: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/download/2020.02.20b/xDrip-plus-20200220-33e5f35.apk. Additionally, a user reported successfully using an 8QXXXX transmitter in no-code mode with xDrip by entering 0000 as the calibration code, which disables factory calibration and avoids the error after warm-up.
